axial_retention: None: square locator and plain tail locate radially; keep assembly supported and gently seated, p0 only.
excluded_real_hardware: Sensor, pusher, pusher nut, steel cassette, preload nut/keeper/adjuster/lock, cassette retention hardware, springs and isometric sleeves.
physical_limitations: Unloaded hand fit/motion only; no squeeze, force, preload, calibration or strength qualification.
PLA rod/pad proxies are shape/fit substitutes only.
Support cleanup and print dimensional fits must be measured; printed .1/.2mm radial/flat clearances are not printer capability guarantees.
